# Live Preview for DeepSeek Harness
中文说明 · Changelog · MIT
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a **live-preview panel** to the Web UI. Pick a workspace, browse

to an HTML
page, and it renders beside the conversation — every save reloads it. The agent can open

pages too, through the
`live_preview` tool.
> Built for the "let me see what you are making" loop: chat on the left, your page on the right, no

t me see what you are making" loop: chat on the left, your page on the right, no window
> switching.
## Features
- Preview panel docked to the right of the Harness UI; drag its left edge to resize, width and devic

e mode are remembered
- Workspace → directory → file browser with an `HTML` badge
- **Auto reload on

save** (SSE, with a version-poll fallback), toggleable, plus a manual reload button.
Only files the

preview actually loaded trigger a reload, so unrelated workspace activity (service logs, data
dumps

) does not keep reloading your page.
- **Focus on what is being edited** — the preview scrolls to an

d outlines the block that just changed, and the panel
shows an "Editing …" chip; automatic on save (

HTML by source line, CSS by rule selector) and available through the tool
- Device widths: full / 76

8 px / 375 px, and open-in-new-tab
- **Survives a Harness restart** — the last open page is remember

ed in the browser and restored when the panel
was open, so a restart no longer leaves it blank
- **S
eparate window** — open the preview in your system default browser and collapse the in-panel view, s

o the
conversation gets its space back; live reload / focus keep working in that window
- Agent tool

`live_preview` with `open` / `close` / `refresh` / `root` / `focus` / `clear`
- Read-only preview s

erver on loopback, one-time token + HttpOnly cookie, realpath containment checks
- The previewed pag
e runs on its own origin, isolated from the Harness UI origin
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (the `dsh web` app or the desktop app)
- Node.js 20+ on the Harne

eek Harness with the Web UI (the `dsh web` app or the desktop app)
- Node.js 20+ on the Harness host
## Install

1. Clone this repository anywhere on the Harness host.
2. Install it as a local bundle — ask the Har
ness agent, or call the plugin manager directly:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

(In the UI: Plugins → Add → local bundle directory.)
3. **Refresh the Web UI** (Ctrl+R). An eye icon
appears in the session header.
> A local-directory install links the checkout in place. If you move or delete the folder, reinstall
rectory install links the checkout in place. If you move or delete the folder, reinstall the bundle.
## Use

- **Eye icon** — open / close the preview panel
- **Workspace dropdown** — switch the preview root (

registered workspaces only)
- **Choose file** — browse folders, click an HTML file to preview it, cl

ick a folder to enter
- **Full / Tablet / Phone** — preview width (phone = 375 px)
- **Auto reload**

— whether file changes reload the page
- **Reload** — reload the current page manually
- **Open in

a new tab** — hand the page to your system browser
- **Separate window** — open the preview in your

default browser and close the panel, for when the panel feels
too wide; auto reload and the edit hig

hlight keep working there. (The desktop shell blocks `window.open`, so
the Host opens it instead.)
-
Drag the panel's left edge to resize it
Ask the agent to open a page for you:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The agent calls `live_preview({ action: "open", path: "maas-home-preview/index.html" })`.
## Focus — show the block being edited
When a watched file changes, the plugin works out *where* the edit landed and tells the preview to p
hed file changes, the plugin works out *where* the edit landed and tells the preview to point at it:
- **HTML** — served pages carry `data-lp-line` markers on elements. The change is diffed against the

last served
revision, and the element nearest the changed source line is scrolled into view and out

lined.
- **CSS** — the selector of the rule surrounding the changed line is resolved and every match

ing element is outlined
(up to 12).
- Other text files — the panel still shows "Editing … · line N"
without a page outline.
The focus is carried through the reload (stored in `sessionStorage`), so it lands after the page has

reloaded.
You can also drive it explicitly:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The panel shows the current target with **Locate** (re-apply) and **×** (clear) actions; it fades af
the current target with **Locate** (re-apply) and **×** (clear) actions; it fades after ~15 seconds.

## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`live_preview` opens a page by resolving the path against the caller's session working directory, th

en picking
the nearest registered workspace as the preview root.
## Security model

- The preview server binds `127.0.0.1` only
- Every file request needs the per-process random token

(`?t=`) or the `dshprev` HttpOnly cookie
- Read-only: no write endpoint
- Each request is checked wi

th `realpath` + containment; `..`, encoded traversal and symlink escapes are rejected
- The previewe

d page gets its own origin, so it cannot read the Harness UI's storage or authenticated API
- No LAN

wn origin, so it cannot read the Harness UI's storage or authenticated API
- No LAN or remote access
## Limitations

- Static files only; a project that needs `npm run dev` is not proxied (planned)
- Pages that call a

bsolute-path backend endpoints will 404
- If the page's own CSP blocks the injected reload script, t

he panel-side fallback still reloads it — that fallback
needs one page refresh after installing/upda

ting
- The boot contract (`window.__ModuleLoader__`, slot APIs) is internal to Harness; a major Harn

ess upgrade may need a
small plugin update
